meta.title: About
meta.subtitle: Technical Director, educator, and API consultant. Based in Wales, UK.

bio: I help SaaS teams fix slow, unreliable APIs without rewriting everything. My work sits at the intersection of API quality, architecture, and delivery -- the decisions that determine whether a team ships with confidence or spends half its time firefighting.

I have been building software professionally for over 15 years, with the last several focused on PHP, Laravel, and API systems at scale. I am a PHP-FIG Core Committee member, have delivered 30+ talks and workshops internationally, and have reached over 50,000 developers through writing, talks, and technical education.

Before software, I served in the Royal Engineers from 2007 to 2011. That background shapes how I work: systematic diagnosis, calm under pressure, and a strong preference for durable solutions over short-term fixes.

My consulting approach runs in three stages: diagnose the actual failure points, stabilise the riskiest bottlenecks first, then scale by leaving behind patterns and habits the team can own without me.
